candidates.formal_type: (A : Type u_1) → [inst : Ring.{u_1} A] → Ideal.{u_1} A

∀ (A : Type u) [inst : Ring.{u} A] (a : A),
  Iff (Membership.mem.{u, u} (Etingof.Radical.{u} A) a)
    (∀ (V : Type u) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u} V] [inst_2 : Module.{u, u} A V] [IsSimpleModule.{u, u} A V] (v : V),
      Eq.{u + 1} (HSMul.hSMul.{u, u, u} a v) 0)

source_text: The radical of A is the set of elements acting by zero in every irreducible A-representation, denoted Rad(A).
